name: SenRate
description: Pass rate & consistency tracker: per-part pass rates, 100%s from every start pos and tips on what to practice.

part-size.name: Part Size (%)
part-size.description: How big each part of the level is when calculating per-part pass rates.

recent-window.name: Recent Runs Window
recent-window.description: How many of your latest runs are used for the 'Recent' view and the improvement trend.

min-samples.name: Minimum Samples for Tips
min-samples.description: A part needs at least this many runs entering it before SenRate gives advice about it.

track-practice.name: Track Practice Mode
track-practice.description: Also record runs made in practice mode (from the checkpoint you respawn at).

noclip-mode.name: Noclip Runs
noclip-mode.description:
What to do with attempts where noclip saved you.
<cy>Count all</c>: every hit ends a run and a new one starts right there, until the end of the level (start at 25%, hits at 27% and 60% = runs 25-27, 27-60 and 60-100).
<cy>Count until first hit</c>: only the run up to your first hit counts (25-27).
<cy>Ignore</c>: nothing is recorded.

level-button.name: Level Page Button
level-button.description: Adds the SenRate button to the level info page (and to local levels).

end-screen.name: End Screen Summary
end-screen.description: Shows how many times you've made it to 100% from your start pos on the level complete screen.

completion-toast.name: Completion Notification
completion-toast.description: Shows a small notification with your updated pass rate every time you reach 100%.
